meta.name: cram-bench-real-v1
meta.description: Real-repo tier: tasks pinned to a real upstream repo at a bugfix commit's PARENT (bug present), with a clean-room regression test overlaid as the oracle (red->green). Requires network to clone. This is where context optimizers should actually show value — a large, unfamiliar codebase with real orientation cost.

tasks.prompt: This is a clone of the `click` library. A group declared with `@click.group(invoke_without_command=True)` prints its --help synopsis as `Usage: cli [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`, but since the group can run without a subcommand the subcommand should be marked optional: `Usage: cli [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...`. Find where the command synopsis/metavar is built and fix it so an optional subcommand is bracketed (required subcommands must stay unbracketed). Verify with `PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest oracle_test.py -q`. Do not edit oracle_test.py.
